name: weight-p2
description: Weighting training positions by the model's own uncertainty as the only factor (11-12 ~08:40; analyst 6.72 (c) 3, spec 6.73): a pure F-P field at ply 2 (as fponly-p2), F-P x2 with the flag off (controls; chessai-weight1 trains them byte-identically to hybrid6) and F-P x2 with --weight-by-uncertainty score (s = P(W) + P(D)/2 from the pre-update prediction, u = 4 s(1-s) clipped to [0.2, 1], w = u / running mean (memory 1M), cap 3; probit through the likelihood power). Seed 58, 1,584 games a cycle, self-games, floor 300, cap 400, hybrid17 games, recipe row F-P-w (chessai-weight1 training). Predictions (6.72-6.74): weighted over controls 0-40 at ply 2; within 20 at ply 3. Rule: 30+ over = adopt for the league's flats; within 15 = the lever closes; 30+ below = decided positions carry information the ranking needs (closes it too). Read: models/from-scratch/global11-drafts/weight-p2-read.sh (panel y + v + l at v299 plus x4 and x4b, v150 / v300 / final, plies 2, 1 and 3) and the side read fastbin/weight1/uloss.py (full and winner loss, overall and on undecided positions, weighted vs control in the same run).
